Use `box-sizing: border-box` to include padding and border within the set width. - Layout Models: - Flexbox: One-dimensional layout (row or column) controlled via `display: flex`, `justify-content` (main axis), and `align-items` (cross axis). - CSS Grid: Two-dimensional layout using rows and columns via `display: grid` and `grid-template-columns`. - Responsive Design: Utilizes media queries (`@media (max-width: 600px)`) and flexible units (`%, fr`) to adapt layouts across mobile and desktop viewports. - Visual Effects: Enhancements include `border-radius`, gradients, shadows (`box-shadow`, `text-shadow`), 2D/3D transformations, transitions, and CSS variables (`--variable-name` accessed via `var()`). ## Exam Takeaways - Specificity and Cascade Rules: Specificity determines winners first; ties are resolved by the later rule in the stylesheet. - Block vs. Inline Elements: Block elements start on a new line and take full width (`
